dct_description_sm:
This map shows the projected average change in mean temperature (°C) for 2046-2065, with respect to the reference period of 1986-2005 for RCP8.5. The median projected change across the ensemble of CMIP5 climate models is shown.  
  
                 For more maps on projected change, please visit the Canadian Climate Data and Scenarios (CCDS) site: https://climate-scenarios.canada.ca/?page=download-cmip5.
dct_title_s: Projected average change in mean temperature for 2046-2065 based on RCP8.5 (50th percentile)
